name: zwomp-survives
description: G8 (John 15:22): barely doesn't kill Zwomp. Nobody plays until 40 s (the round is the tape: barely has planted B and holds Catwalk), then the human takes barely over and stands still without firing. Zwomp, walking up Catwalk on his recorded route, isn't killed at 44.2 s: his recorded killer is the human, so 3 s later his fate is gone and he plays on as a normal CT for good (retake): he fights what he sees and goes for the planted bomb to defuse it, or dies trying; the round ends by the rules.
